caption: Kerkruïne, Schokland

description: The Kerkruïne is the foundation walls of the old Ens church on the south point of Schokland. The walls above ground were taken down by 1821, and the 2002 work conserved the foundations rather than rebuilding a church. No tower stands. It is overcast, about 10.7°C, with wind near 6.1 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. This is polder grass and trees, not the sea. The Middelbuurt church and the keeper's house are other scenes and are not in this frame. Lettering on the memorial stone is not readable.
